purpose: Primary-source material-field evidence batch for Portugal study and remote-work residence pathways.
policy: Only exact route claims supported by current official sources are included; promotion still requires evidenceIds and complete material-field coverage.

records.claim: Portugal's higher-education residence route applies to students admitted or enrolled in an eligible higher-education programme; AIMA requires proof of enrolment/admission and the applicable residence conditions under Article 91.
records.methodology: Direct review of current AIMA higher-education residence authorization guidance.

records.claim: Portugal requires third-country nationals to demonstrate sufficient means of subsistence under its applicable rules; AIMA identifies proof of subsistence for higher-education residence applications and links the calculation to Portaria 1563/2007, with evidence varying by the applicant's circumstances.
records.methodology: Direct review of current AIMA subsistence-means guidance and the higher-education residence requirements; no unsupported universal study-cost figure is asserted.

records.claim: Portugal's remote-work residence route requires a valid residence visa for remote professional activity performed for an entity or client outside Portugal and supporting proof of the foreign employment or service relationship.
records.methodology: Direct review of current AIMA remote-work residence authorization guidance.

records.claim: Portugal's subsistence rules use the applicable national minimum-wage reference and allow remote-work applicants to prove means through employment or service contracts and related income evidence; no unsupported single net-income figure is asserted here.
records.methodology: Direct review of current AIMA subsistence-means guidance, including remote-work proof mechanisms.
